name: Octopus Agile
author: Marius Fanu
description: Live Octopus Agile electricity prices with cheapest windows and day chart

barWidget.description: Current Agile price pill with full-day popup

schema.label: Next-slot arrow
schema.description: Show ↑ or ↓ on the pill when the next half-hour is a different price.

schema.label: Cheap window alerts
schema.description: Desktop notification before a cheap or plunge slot. Off by default.

schema.label: Alert lead time (minutes)
schema.description: How far ahead of a cheap slot to notify.

schema.label: Alert below (p/kWh)
schema.description: Notify when an upcoming slot is below this price. Negative (plunge) always alerts when enabled.
